items.quote: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink.
items.claim: The people argued with Moses and demanded water to drink.

items.quote: And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
items.claim: Moses asked the people why they argued with him and said they were testing the LORD.
items.mechanism: sees their complaint as testing the LORD

items.quote: And the people thirsted there for water
items.claim: The people were thirsty because there was no water there.

items.quote: and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
items.claim: The people complained against Moses, accusing him of bringing them out of Egypt to let them, their children and their cattle die of thirst.
items.mechanism: thirst leading to fear of death and resentment of leaving Egypt

items.quote: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
items.claim: Moses cried out to the LORD for guidance, saying the people were close to stoning him.
items.mechanism: threat of violence from the people
